Regional autism-associated gene candidates

Scope: the app’s existing 20-gene protein library. These results are not a genome-wide ranking, a diagnosis, an ASD/control contrast, or a measure of causal importance.

Genetic evidence

Eligible genes have SFARI score 1 (High Confidence) or 2 (Strong Candidate) in the official Human Gene table retrieved 28 October 2026. Genetic categories and report counts are retained. Report counts and syndromic status are not ranking weights. SFARI provides evidence about association overall, not region-specific causal evidence. The archived source page, exact selected rows and checksum are preserved in the project research folder.

Regional enrichment

For each eligible gene, take the arithmetic mean of nTPM across the source areas assigned to the selected cortical parcel. Divide by the arithmetic mean of that gene’s nTPM across all other unique source areas in the SAME study, excluding target areas. HPA human brain has 193 source areas; the separate prefrontal study has 20. Never pool or compare these studies. Different studies cover different anatomy, so rankings across them are not directly equivalent. Missing mappings, missing inputs or nonpositive baselines do not produce a ranking; no pseudocount is added.

Require a regional mean ≥1 nTPM and ≥1.25-fold enrichment. The 1.25 threshold is a descriptive interface choice, not a validated biological cutoff, significance test or study-author criterion. Sort by enrichment descending, regional mean descending, then gene symbol alphabetically. Return at most three. Do not fill gaps with genes that fail the rule.

Expanded postcentral and precentral sampling

The lab prototype includes the unsuffixed source entry plus dorsal, middle and ventral subdivisions. For TBR1 postcentral, the four means are 105.0, 65.1, 84.8 and 85.8 nTPM, giving an equal-area mean of 85.175 nTPM. Each contributes 25%, even though the entries contain 1, 6, 5 and 3 tissue samples. The 15 tissue samples do not establish 15 independent donors. This deliberately reproduces the linked prototype’s equal-area method; it does not fix the separate weighting limitation. Individual measurements and direct source anchors appear in the evidence panel.

Limits

nTPM means normalized transcripts per million and measures RNA, not protein. The averages are across source-area summaries, not donor-level means. Equally weighted source areas can differ in size, sampling and biological relationships. No uncertainty intervals or cell-type, age or donor adjustments are available here. Reference-brain expression does not establish autism-specific dysregulation.

Adult atlas parcels map by anatomical names, not a registration of measurements to this brain. Related or broader matches can cause multiple parcels to share the same source values and rankings. Left and right use identical expression evidence. A broadly expressed gene such as NRXN1 may still qualify where its regional enrichment meets the rule.

Audit and sources

Rankings, formula and genetic evidence · Underlying mapped HPA values · HPA studies, anatomical crosswalk, licensing and attribution. The reproducible build uses preserved complete per-gene source-area tables, including areas outside the visible cortex.
